behavior_requirements.description: Reject dirty, stale, unpublished, untrusted-CI, invalid-first-parent, diverged-main, or unsafe recovery operations without advancing the target branch or publishing a recovery ref.
Pin exact SHAs, avoid main and tag pushes, and exact-lease-delete only unchanged feature or reserved main-CI refs after real CI success.
Publish and poll exact feature or rewritten-main tips, complete supported merges, clean eligible evidence refs, and report independent merge and cleanup outcomes.

entries.rationale: Existing integration coverage is retained as the first canonical suite.

owner.name: AI tooling policy and MCP registration

entries.rationale: Offline suites cover AI tooling drift and deterministic MCP validation, filtering, executable resolution, replacement, and failure propagation without changing real Claude configuration.
The suite covers launch contracts plus real Git lifecycle, path, lock, cleanup, and partial-failure recovery behavior.
The provenance suite proves archived scripts remain classified and absent from behavioral suites.

behavior_requirements.description: Return nonzero and preserve actionable ERROR diagnostics for required audit failures.
Keep managed-target validation dry-run only and avoid applying repository or host changes.
Dispatch managed, repository-only, template, shell, PowerShell, and config checks consistently.

entries.rationale: Isolated POSIX and PowerShell fixtures cover classification, worktree routing, template and parser failures, advisory controls, and the managed-target dry-run boundary.

behavior_requirements.description: Block pin drift, malformed release data, API failures, and hazardous successor notes.
Reject redirects and pagination outside the trusted Beads GitHub API before sending credentials.
Accept matching pins when no newer release exists or every successor is clean.

entries.rationale: The registered suite covers pin validation, SemVer ordering, release hazards, and trusted API boundaries.

behavior_requirements.description: Propagate pull, push, server, and remote failures without claiming synchronization succeeded.
Reject unsafe remotes and native-Windows peer operations before contacting or mutating Beads state.
Dispatch supported shell and launcher operations to the intended guarded command.

entries.rationale: Registered helper and isolated sync suites cover launcher dispatch, platform and remote guards, dirty-state refusal, one-session pull SQL, snapshot boundaries, lifecycle cleanup, failure propagation, and URL redaction.
A registered offline suite covers manifest and path contracts, deterministic check/write behavior, drift diagnostics, and the download-before-write safety boundary.

behavior_requirements.description: Fail closed for terminal, malformed, unreachable, ambiguous-history, invalid-policy, and missing guarded tracking states.
Select only the exact linear tip or valid no-ff feature parent, preserve the pre-push contract, and block rebasing guarded local-ahead main even when the pipeline override exists.
Dispatch the automatic Linux fast lane and manual platform lanes with their registered suite contracts.
Report exact-SHA success, retryable, terminal, error, and explicit bypass outcomes for guarded automation.

entries.rationale: Offline contract suites cover job dispatch, exact-SHA status reporting, and the fail-closed feature-pipeline guard.
Offline unit and temporary-Git suites cover review-gate state transitions, transcript validation, checkout isolation, path policy, legacy migration, and conservative wrapper fallbacks.

The suite stubs the CLI, Keychain, and network to cover exit-code mapping, per-source reporting, and token non-disclosure. Divergence cases assert that the Claude Code credential alone drives the exit code and that a healthy OpenCode token cannot mask a rejected one. Keychain discovery is macOS-gated and skips elsewhere, where the credentials file is the Claude Code source.

behavior_requirements.description: Reject invalid lifecycle and dependency configuration with actionable diagnostics.
Reject invalid relay arguments and unsafe socket state with actionable diagnostics.
Reject malformed workspace override inputs without corrupting the active configuration.
Keep live lifecycle validation inside disposable containers without exposing host secrets or config.
Exercise lifecycle functions without running installers or mutating host paths.
Repeat lifecycle persistence and materialization with the expected container state.
Relay concurrent bidirectional SSH-agent traffic and clean up sockets reliably.
Merge and remap workspace overrides repeatedly with stable output.

entries.rationale: Ownership remains here until dots-7mx performs the planned same-path submodule split. Isolated suites cover lifecycle persistence and materialization, workspace override parsing and replacement, and concurrent socket relay behavior without installers or host mutation. The opt-in smoke uses a preloaded image, synthetic read-only inputs, no network, unique resources, bounded commands, and guaranteed cleanup to validate the safe production runtime phases across create, restart, and rerun. Package installers and optional network integrations remain outside the smoke boundary.

Registered standard-library tests cover session-name normalization and ref safety plus synthetic receipt parsing, formatting, mixed-case offer-code selection, CopyQ fallback, and secret-safe failures without accessing a real clipboard.
Executable mode or chezmoi naming creates a candidate signal, but these files contain data rather than automation logic.
Tests exercise production automation but are not themselves production automation targets.
Generated copies are checked against their canonical manifests and template chains rather than tested as independent implementations.

behavior_requirements.description: Reject dotted, nested, and CRLF sync.remote settings and restore only a known-safe tracked baseline without changing unrelated staged or working files.
Block guarded main rebases when local commits are absent from the policy remote tracking ref and fail closed when that tracking state is unavailable.
Consume coauthor one-shot state before message handling, deduplicate CRLF trailers, preserve unrelated message content, and clean temporary files on success or failure.
Keep pipeline hooks repository-opt-in, allow non-main and no-ahead rebases, and prevent the pipeline override from silently authorizing a guarded-main rebase.
Resolve local, global, and default coauthor trailers and insert the selected trailer before scissors or at the end exactly once.
Discover, install, update, and remove owned template hooks while preserving unrelated repository hooks.
Execute-probe Python candidates for guarded hooks, reject broken command shims, fall through to a working launcher, and fail closed when none works.

entries.rationale: Contract suites cover hook ownership, synchronization, executable Beads and coauthor behavior, exact-SHA push enforcement, and guarded-main rebase protection.

behavior_requirements.description: Retain collision-safe recovery state, the exact gpls stash, and any owned CI evidence ref across rebase, CI, remote-movement, cleanup, and finalization failures.
Publish only the SHA-derived reserved CI ref, lease-delete only unchanged evidence, and never push guarded main or tags.
Rebase a clean ahead-and-behind guarded main onto a pinned remote tip, obtain exact-SHA CI, restore any exact stash, and leave main ahead and ready for a separate push.

entries.rationale: Core integration tests and platform adapters cover the guarded sync state machine while agent-helper regressions preserve its shared runtime contract.
Fixture tests cover discovery, schema validation, exact-once classification, and drift.

behavior_requirements.description: Reject active or malformed legacy backend state, unhealthy GitHub replacements, and failed mise mutations or postconditions with nonzero ERROR diagnostics.
Propagate selected lifecycle hook command and validation failures with actionable diagnostics.
Prevent unsupported-host mutation, unrelated formula or tap removal in untested retirement hooks, installer side effects, and production secret access across untested lifecycle hooks.
Retire only fully qualified versions discovered under the exact UBI backend on Darwin or WSL2 while preserving unrelated installs and unsupported hosts.
Remove all inactive legacy UBI CBM versions, reshim, verify the active GitHub replacement, and no-op idempotently when the backend is absent.
Render and execute the selected host refresh hook idempotently against synthetic state.

entries.rationale: Selected hooks have isolated tests, including exact-backend CBM retirement with failure and idempotence coverage; the full lifecycle render and execution matrix remains planned.

behavior_requirements.description: Fail before launch when OpenSSH is unavailable and report fingerprint-verification and known_hosts remediation for SSH host-key failures.
Preserve timeout classification through cleanup, stop later Claude mutations after the first timeout, continue OpenCode work, and return nonzero for a later retry.
Propagate selected installer, parser, and refresh failures without reporting success.
Override interactive Git SSH transport only in Claude mutation children with strict OpenSSH host-key checking and no terminal prompts, without changing caller environment.
Contain each Claude mutation, reap descendants after normal exit or timeout, fail closed before an uncontained launch, and preserve unrelated processes.
Keep broad lifecycle tests from mutating the real Windows profile, installers, or production secrets.
Complete bounded Claude mutation commands with compatible output, exit status, and child-local environment behavior.
Render and execute selected Windows installer and refresh paths idempotently in synthetic state.

entries.rationale: Selected installers have tests; broad Pester and rendered-template coverage remains planned.

owner.name: managed AI adapters and destructive guards

behavior_requirements.description: Remain silent and clear transient state for failed or no-op commits and repositories without a valid feature-CI capability contract.
Reject invalid profile and project dependency state with stable nonzero diagnostics.
Reject malformed requests and state, preserve conservative provider fallback behavior, and keep permission capture failures from changing permission decisions.
Enforce destructive Beads policy when hook prerequisites parse successfully, preserve fail-open behavior when they do not, and prevent adapters from exposing or using production secrets in tests.
Limit post-commit adapters to local Git inspection and context injection without publication, merge, ref deletion, or implicit permission expansion.
Start the Claude Code Router once, skip an already-listening port, and record launch failures without affecting the real router.
Inject equivalent repository-scoped prepare-ci guidance after successful HEAD-changing wrapper commits in Claude and OpenCode.
Map quota, cited-search, permission-capture, and router requests through their supported cache, citation, redaction, and model-preset contracts.
Refresh valid profiles and accept valid project dependency state through isolated adapters.

entries.rationale: Registered offline suites cover managed OpenCode and CCR compatibility, destructive Beads policy, feature-CI reminders, profiles, dependency guards, and CCR launch idempotency without live credentials, network, or Beads mutations.
Container copies are checked against Git-tracked host sources and mirror cleanup rules rather than duplicate behavioral suites.
Fixture tests cover authority derivation, exact divergence locks, mirror drift, and behavioral-suite exclusions.

Isolated Node contract tests cover review event and state transitions, strict gate clearing, editor suppression lifecycle, redacted event logging, malformed inputs, and swallowed client or filesystem failures without npm or host-state dependencies.

Environment loading and real-repository gpls tests cover clean pulls, exact stash restoration, conflict recovery, temporary-worktree cleanup, paths with spaces, and argument refusal; broader startup ordering and remaining helpers are still planned.

Registered offline suites cover devcontainer mirror idempotency and cleanup, sync/render sequencing, fixture-scoped secret rendering, wrapper dispatch, statusline drift, and workspace override merging and remapping. Behavioral coverage for sync-plannotator-assets.py remains planned.
Contract tests cover delegation, suite selection, isolation, capability handling, and shared fixtures.

Registered offline suites cover notifications, devcontainer launch actions, commit and editor wrappers, host Plannotator profiles, NFS path and lock safety, and VNC preference/process transitions. Maintenance tests use fake system commands and bounded fixture state; the macOS smoke only parses sources. The broad row remains partial because the Beads kanban sync and Promptfoo wrappers do not yet have behavioral coverage.

entries.rationale: Local parity, version markers, entrypoints, and integrity locks cover provenance without duplicating upstream behavioral suites.

entries.rationale: Native-Windows guarded gpls dispatch has a registered platform test; profiles, drive mapping, Pageant, environment fragments, and commit wrappers still need broader coverage.

behavior_requirements.description: Propagate bootstrap, package, and command-bearing Ansible task failures with actionable diagnostics.
Keep provisioning smoke tests disposable and prevent mutation of the developer's active WSL2 installation or secrets.
Complete bootstrap and Ansible provisioning idempotently with the expected WSL2 state.
